item.title: Duel at Dawn
item.description: A dueling game where you face off against an opponent. side view perspective. My goal is to start learning combat mechanics. My own art from Asprite - animated myself My own background music - built in Reaper Found for sound effects, know some podcasts that use it will test that out Using sound effects - using or found in Reaper Lots to learn here but native linux and found Blipsounds as knowledge source who also uses it Movement system side to side Basic AI to fight against Juice - particles and sounds that make feeling of hitting good Combat system Light attack Heavy attack Stretch Block Counter Faint 2025-11-22 Getting setup my scope and tooling.
